headline: Morocco Overtakes South Africa in RMB Continental Investment Ranking
summary: Morocco surpassed South Africa in the RMB Continental Investment Ranking, driven by 4.9% economic growth in 2025 and manufacturing expansion compared to South Africa's 1.1% growth.
why: The RMB Continental Investment Ranking provides institutional investors with a benchmark for evaluating economic performance and investment attractiveness across African markets.

impacts.name: Manufacturing
impacts.why: Manufacturing expansion helped drive Morocco's economic growth and its ranking rise.
